suspects.roleTh: หลานชาย อายุ 10 ขวบ
suspects.secret: Grandpa Wang's 10-year-old grandson. At 3:30 he secretly borrowed the jade to show his friends in the garden, because they did not believe his family has a dragon jade. The jade is now in his school bag upstairs. He is nervous and tries to hide it: he says he was in his room playing on his phone, but his red sneakers are muddy from the garden. If asked about the jade or his bag he says 'nothing' and changes the subject. He never confesses by himself.
